name: Back cover
clue: The outer shell that protects the back of the phone.
fact: A glued back must be warmed before it will lift. A clip back releases at the seam.

name: Camera bump
clue: The raised area that holds the lenses.
fact: The glass near the camera is often the thinnest, so keep picks away from it.

name: Side buttons
clue: Pressed from the edge to power on or change the volume.
fact: Buttons are usually linked to the phone by a thin flex cable, so never pull on them.

name: Battery
clue: The large, flat pouch that stores the phone's power.
fact: It is a lithium pouch. Never bend or puncture it, because it can catch fire.

name: Adhesive pull tabs
clue: Small tabs used to release the glue under the battery.
fact: Pull them slowly and low, almost flat against the phone, so that they do not snap.

name: Battery connector
clue: The small press-on plug at the end of the battery's cable.
fact: This is the first thing to unplug in most repairs. Use plastic tools only.

name: Mainboard
clue: The large green circuit board that everything connects to.
fact: It holds the processor and memory, and it links every other part of the phone.

name: Rear camera module
clue: The dark block with round lenses, near the top corner.
fact: It plugs into the mainboard with its own small connector, so it can be swapped.

name: Metal shield
clue: A silver cover that sits over sensitive chips.
fact: Shields block electrical interference. Leave them in place during basic repairs.

name: Chip
clue: A small black part soldered to the board, with no silver cover.
fact: Chips are also called integrated circuits. They are soldered on, so they cannot be swapped with basic tools.

name: Battery socket
clue: The gold socket on the board where the battery plugs in.
fact: Press connectors straight down. Going in at an angle can bend the socket's pins.

name: Charging board
clue: The small orange board along the bottom edge.
fact: On many phones this is a separate part that can be replaced with basic tools.

name: Charging port
clue: Where the charging cable plugs in.
fact: Always clean out lint and try another cable before you replace a port.

name: Microphone
clue: A tiny round part that picks up your voice.
fact: It often sits on the charging board, so faint calls can point to this part.

name: Loudspeaker
clue: The slotted area that plays sound.
fact: Dust in the mesh can muffle it, so check for dirt before you replace it.

name: Flex cable
clue: The long, thin ribbon running up the side.
fact: Flex cables carry power and signals. They tear easily, so never pull on them.

name: Flex connector
clue: The gold plug at the top end of the ribbon.
fact: Lift connectors straight up from their edges with a plastic spudger.

name: Display panel
clue: The large panel that fills the frame. You are seeing its inside face.
fact: Bending the panel can break it, so support it whenever you handle it.

name: Display connector
clue: The orange cable joint on the panel.
fact: Always disconnect the battery before you unplug a display cable.
